;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War]]
***[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and his administration are considering replacing the U.S. military forces in [[Syria]] with a regional Arab force. [https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/trump-reportedly-seeks-an-arab-force-to-replace-the-u-s-in-syria-1.6010132 (''Haaretz'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Yom Hazikaron|Memorial Day]]
***[[Israel]] holds services remembering 23,646 Israeli [[Israeli Defence Forces|soldiers]] and 3,134 civilians killed in the conflict. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-prepares-to-remember-23646-fallen-soldiers-and-3134-terror-victims/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], speaking at a Foreign Ministry ceremony commemorating the nation's sixteen diplomats killed in service, states security services are prepared to foil possible attacks on diplomats by [[Iran]]. [http://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Benjamin-Netanyahu/Netanyahu-Israel-on-guard-against-Iranian-terror-attacks-on-diplomats-550062 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
***[[Egypt]] invites rival [[Politics of Palestine|Palestinian factions]] [[Fatah]] and [[Hamas]] to meet in [[Cairo]] in a bid to halt violent protests at the Israeli-[[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]n border. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/middle-east/172488-180417-egypt-invites-palestinian-blocs-in-bid-to-resume-reconciliation-halt-gaza-riots (i24 News)]
*The names of 3,607 employees of [[Unit 731]], a [[Japan]]ese military medical experimentation unit associated with [[war crimes]] during [[World War II]], are released. Prosecutors in the [[United States]] had kept their identities secret following the war in exchange for access to data gleaned from the project. [http://www.newsweek.com/identities-japanese-war-crimes-unit-killed-pows-released-889544 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Terrorism in Spain]]
**Eight people go on trial in [[Navarra]], [[Spain]], accused of terrorism after an alleged attack on two [[Civil Guard (Spain)|Civil Guards]] in a controversial case with the prosecution seeking a total 375 years imprisonment for the defendants. The defence claims the incident was nothing more than a bar brawl and [[Amnesty International]] describes the charges as "inappropriate". [https://www.thelocal.es/20180417/controversial-spain-terror-bar-brawl-trial-opens (''The Local'')]
*A grenade explodes in [[Moyale]], [[Ethiopia]], killing three people and injuring dozens. [http://www.africanews.com/2018/04/17/bomb-blast-in-ethiopia-kills-3-oromia-region-blames-ethio-somali-militia/ (Africa News)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**[[Iraq]] sentences seven foreign women for links to [[ISIL|Islamic State]]. Three [[Azerbaijan]]is and one [[Kyrgyzstan|Kergyz]] receive [[capital punishment|death sentences]] while two [[Russia]]ns and a [[France|French]] women receive [[life imprisonment|life sentences]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/iraq-sentences-french-woman-to-life-over-is-links/ (Iraqi News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[list of shipwrecks in 2018|Shipwrecks in 2018]]
**[[Disasters in Indonesia]]
***Oil exploration ship MV ''Ocean Geos'' catches fire after an explosion on board off Kuala Baram, [[Indonesia]]. Of the crew, 37 are evacuated including two injured and one more remains missing. Four firefighting tugs are in attendance. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2018/04/358309/update-offshore-drilling-ship-catches-fire-1-missing-2-injured-nsttv (''The New Straits Times'')] [http://www.osjonline.com/news/view,tugs-tackle-fatal-fire-on-oil-exploration-ship_51442.htm (Offshore Support Journal Online)]
**Tanker ships MT ''Crystal Sunrise'' and MT ''Astro Saturn'' collide off [[Singapore]], causing damage to both vessels and a butane leak. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/butane-leak-tanker-collision-off-singapore-coast-results-in-10147870 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[Southwest Airlines Flight 1380]]
**A passenger jet suffers an [[uncontained engine failure]] during a flight from [[LaGuardia Airport]] in [[New York City]] to [[Dallas Love Field]] in [[Dallas|Dallas, Texas]]. One passenger is killed. The aircraft diverts to [[Philadelphia International Airport]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43803340 (BBC)]
*[[Disasters in Indonesia]]
**A bridge linking [[Lamongan|Babat, Lamongan]], and [[Tuban Regency|Widang, Tuban]], in [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]], collapses. Several vehicles fall into the [[Bengawan Solo River]], killing at least two truckers. [https://www.driving.co.uk/news/two-truck-drivers-killed-east-java-bridge-collapse/ (''The Sunday Times'')]

;Health and environment
*The [[European Commission]] rules [[Poland]]'s logging operations in the [[Białowieża Forest]], a [[UNESCO World Heritage]] site, are a violation of international law. [https://www.independent.co.uk/environment/poland-logging-ancient-forest-eu-court-ruling-bialowieza-a8308216.html (''The Independent'')]

;International relations
*[[April 2018 inter-Korean summit|2018 inter-Korean summit]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] announce that they are planning to officially end the [[Korean War]] by writing a peace agreement. An [[Korean Armistice Agreement|armistice agreement]] was reached, ending armed conflict, in 1953. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] called the decision to end the war a blessing.  [http://www.businessinsider.com/north-south-korea-may-announce-peace-2018-4?r=UK&IR=T (''Business Insider'')], [http://www1.cbn.com/cbnnews/national-security/2018/april/is-war-between-north-and-south-korea-over-president-trump-gives-his-blessing-on-that (CBN)]
*[[2018 North Korea–United States summit]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
**United States officials state that [[Director of the Central Intelligence Agency]] [[Mike Pompeo]] met with [[North Korea]] leader [[Kim Jong-un]]. [https://www.wbir.com/article/news/nation-world/mike-pompeo-met-with-n-koreas-kim-jong-un-us-officials-say/507-541522329 (WBIR-TV)]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Europe]]
**The [[European Commission]] announces plans to force tech companies worldwide that provide services within the [[European Union]] to supply data on their users in counterterror investigations. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/17/eu-to-force-tech-firms-to-hand-over-terror-suspects-messages (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]]
**Two families of victims of the 2012 [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]] file a defamation lawsuit against far-right radio show host and conspiracy theorist [[Alex Jones]], as well as his website [[InfoWars]] for his false claims surrounding the school shooting.[https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/apr/17/alex-jones-sued-infowars-sandy-hook-parents-defamation (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Berlin anti-semitic attack]]
**Two [[Israel]]i men wearing [[kippah]]s are attacked in [[Berlin]], Germany. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43812273 (BBC)]
*8,500 prisoners are granted [[amnesty]] in [[Myanmar]] by [[President of Myanmar|President]] [[Win Myint (politician, born 1951)|Win Myint]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/myanmar-president-grants-amnesty/4351503.html (Voice of America)]
*Officials announce the arrests in [[Iraq]] of two men suspected of plotting terror attacks for [[ISIL|Islamic State]]  in [[Australia]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-04-18/alleged-sydney-bomb-leader-and-is-fighter-arrested-in-iraq/9668012 (ABC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Armenia]]
**Amid anti-government protests, [[Armenia]]'s [[National Assembly (Armenia)|National Assembly]] swears in former President [[Serzh Sargsyan]] as [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]]. The opposition call the move a "power grab". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43794910 (BBC)]
*Former [[First Lady of the United States|U.S. First Lady]] [[Barbara Bush]] dies at age 92. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-people-barbarabush/barbara-bush-wife-and-mother-of-u-s-presidents-dies-at-92-idUSKBN1HO3HG (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*In [[Los Angeles]], [[SpaceX]] announced that they will build a [[BFR (rocket)|massive rocket named BFR]] capable of sending humans to [[Mars]]. [https://www.pcmag.com/news/360465/spacex-to-build-its-massive-mars-rocket-in-los-angeles (''PC Magazine'')]
*New research suggests the [[Almahata Sitta]] meteorites are evidence of a lost additional planet in the [[Solar System]]. [http://www.sciencemag.org/news/2018/04/diamond-studded-meteorites-came-collision-lost-planet (''Science'')]
*The [[lesser long-nosed bat]], once on the brink of extinction, is removed from the [[United States Fish and Wildlife Service list of endangered mammals and birds]]. It is the first [[United States|U.S.]] bat species to officially recover from the imminent threat of extinction. [https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2018/04/lesser-long-nosed-bats-conservation-delisted-endangered-animals-spd/ (''National Geographic'')]

;Sports

**In ice hockey, the [[Las Vegas Golden Knights]] became the first NHL franchise to complete a 4-game sweep in the postseason during their inaugural season after their victory over the [[Los Angeles Kings]].
